_doc: GENERATED by tools/research_domains.py --build. The six source domains beside the newspapers, their shape and their home. Hand-edit and the gate says so.

domains.title: Civic lists
domains.what: The town's own lists of its own people — the poll books and voter rolls of 1833-1835, and the officers, jurors and subscribers printed beside them.

domains.title: The 1830 federal census
domains.what: Chicago was enumerated in Peoria County in 1830. The named schedule is the object; the county aggregates this project already holds are not it.

domains.title: The 1840 federal census
domains.what: Seventy-five page images and a head-of-household index. 1840 is LATER EVIDENCE and never an 1835 household fact on its own.

domains.title: Church registers
domains.what: Baptisms, marriages and burials — St Mary's 1833-1835 first, because eleven images of its register are already deposited and unread.

domains.title: Books and reminiscences
domains.what: Prose: Fergus' Historical Series, Hubbard's autobiography, H. H. Porter's Short Autobiography, and the memoirs printed beside them.

domains.title: Directories
domains.what: The 1839 Chicago directory and its successors — entry by entry, structured, and crosswalked rather than quoted at second hand.
